category_summary: **Oh-My-Hermes launch week**: The community centerpiece is **@rlaope**'s [introduction of **Oh-My-Hermes (OMH)**](/?date=2026-10-29&category=social#item-562b09759888) — an agent toolkit forged from ~**200B tokens** of iteration, featuring **150+ skills**, long-term memory, graph engineering, and multi-model support. **Agent routing & architecture**: **@rlaope** follows up with a [sharp critique of persona injection in agent harnesses](/?date=2026-10-29&category=social#item-ced2515484d4) ('you are a QA lead', 'you are the CEO'), positioning **OMH subagent routing recipes** as the fix, alongside a [coding-harness tier list ranking **omp** and **omh**](/?date=2026-10-29&category=social#item-ddf006967d8e) at the top of the ecosystem, and a [practical compatibility update](/?date=2026-10-29&category=social#item-71c9dfe448ee) enabling **OMH** with **Hermes Agent v0.22.5** delegation backends via **model_map**. **Product & platform news**: **@Teknium** opened the [**mobile app private beta**](/?date=2026-10-29&category=social#item-08e7d3510e8d) to Hermes contributors — a notable signal of product expansion — while **@NousResearch** confirmed [**Hermes Cloud** subscriptions are now included with onboarding](/?date=2026-10-29&category=social#item-b3335ba9b73d) and clarified [portal-based subscription switching](/?date=2026-10-29&category=social#item-217efa1a3193). **Community sentiment**: strongly positive and builder-heavy. Users praise the [**much smoother install and update process**](/?date=2026-10-29&category=social#item-9c0ad412b79e), **@rlaope** claims the native experience ['gets 2x better every single day'](/?date=2026-10-29&category=social#item-c07b82808366), and multi-provider skill demos (including a personal [**video generation skill**](/?date=2026-10-29&category=social#item-907a2377141a)) broadened perceptions of what OMH can do. Lighter moments — like the cheeky [**social-engineer skill** request to get a **NousCon** RSVP approved](/?date=2026-10-29&category=social#item-414895d64342) — showcased the toolkit's range with humor, while deep-engagement threads ([plugin startup hooks](/?date=2026-10-29&category=social#item-950bf259cf8f), [repo description cleanup](/?date=2026-10-29&category=social#item-ba5ada0341de)) round out a highly engaged, builder-centric week.

items.content:
introducing oh-my-hermes

after burning through 200b tokens dialing in my hermes agent setup, i packaged the entire thing into a single-line install.

github: https://t.co/g1exHwWK5E

it packs 150+ skills, a long-term memory layer with 2x the retention, graph engineering, and dedicated memory-management workflows. you also get multi-model subagent routing plus under-the-hood optimizations like parallel tool execution and evals.

zero friction on your end just install it, hand it a task, and let the automated routing take over. hermes agent is phenomenal, and i genuinely love building around this tech.

i spent a ton of time obsessing over the details, then open-sourced it so you can plug it straight into your workflow. meet oh-my-hermes.

#hermes

items.title: Agent harnesses keep injecting personas: "you are a QA lead", "you are the CEO", "you are a product ...
items.content:
Agent harnesses keep injecting personas: "you are a QA lead", "you are the CEO", "you are a product manager". It doesn't make the work better.

What matters is sending each task to the model that is good at it, at the right reasoning effort.

So we're opening up the Oh-My-Hermes subagent routing recipe. Every subagent picks a category, and the category decides the model.

https://t.co/g1exHwWK5E

THINK DEEP:
- ultrabrain: the hardest reasoning → Claude Opus 5.5 / Claude Fable 5.1 · max
- deep: strong default for hard work → GPT-6.1 Terra · high
- deep-work: long tasks at frontier depth → Claude Opus 5.5 · high
- architect: architecture and system design → Kimi K3.1 Pro / Claude Opus 5.5 · high
- artistry: unconventional, creative work → Claude Opus 5.5 / Kimi K3.1 Pro / Gemini 3.1 Pro · high

BUILD & WRITE:
- capable: strong general work → Kimi K3.1 Pro · medium
- writing: prose and docs → Claude Sonnet 5.5 · high
- visual-engineering: frontend and visual → Kimi K3.1 Pro · high

FAST & LIGHT:
- quick: short tasks → GLM 5.3 Ultrafast · low
- simple-work: small everyday tasks → GPT-6 Luna · low
- unspecified-low: cheap default → Claude Haiku 5.5 · low
- unspecified-high: default working model → DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Ultrafast · medium

ETC:
- image: image generation → GPT Image 2.5 Flare · high
- google-search: research grounded in Google Search → Gemini 3.1 Pro · medium
- x-search: live search on X → Grok 4.7 · high
- review: a different model tries to break the diff → GPT-6.1 Sol · xhigh
- swarm: many parallel workers on separate slices → DeepSeek Flash · low
- forensics: root-causing a live symptom or a trace → GPT-6 Astra · xhigh
- synthesize: merging many results into one answer → Claude Opus 5.5 · xhigh

No persona. Just the right model for the job.
